title: Onboarding checklist: step → docs/quickstart/examples link map (Hosted API MVP)
content:
Purpose
- Single source of truth for Console checklist deep-links: each step must point to (1) canonical docs URL, (2) quickstart section anchor, (3) reference example repo file.
- Also tracks gaps (missing doc/page/section/example), so Console copy + docs work stay aligned.

Assumptions / conventions
- Canonical docs base: https://docs.redwoodinference.com
- Quickstart base: https://docs.redwoodinference.com/quickstarts
- Example repos (GitHub org): https://github.com/redwoodinference
- Console deep-links will generally go to Console pages, but the “Learn more” secondary action uses the URLs below.

Table (exported)
| Step ID | Checklist step (Console label) | Acceptance criteria (short) | Canonical docs URL (target) | Quickstart (section anchor) | Example repo + file (reference) | Primary owner | Status | Gaps / notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| STEP-01 | Create an API key | User creates a key in Console; knows where to rotate/revoke | https://docs.redwoodinference.com/account/api-keys | https://docs.redwoodinference.com/quickstarts/hosted-api#get-an-api-key | redwood-quickstarts/production-readiness/README.md#api-key | Kaitlyn Nguyen / Wei Chen | In progress | Docs tightened in redwood-docs/pr-926. Need to add a 30s “where to find it again” callout + rotation link. |
| STEP-02 | Set environment variables | REDWOOD_API_KEY set; local env verified | https://docs.redwoodinference.com/account/environment-variables | https://docs.redwoodinference.com/quickstarts/hosted-api#configure-your-environment | redwood-quickstarts/production-readiness/README.md#environment-setup | Wei Chen | In progress | Add explicit Windows PowerShell examples (frequent Support ask). Also add “don’t quote the key” troubleshooting. |
| STEP-03 | Make your first request (2xx) | First successful 2xx completion/chat/embeddings call | https://docs.redwoodinference.com/api/quickstart | https://docs.redwoodinference.com/quickstarts/hosted-api#make-your-first-request | redwood-quickstarts/hosted-api-hello-world/README.md | Sabrina James | Draft | Need to ensure examples use production-safe timeout defaults (align with SDK presets). |
| STEP-04 | Try streaming | User receives streamed tokens; understands how to close stream | https://docs.redwoodinference.com/guides/streaming | https://docs.redwoodinference.com/quickstarts/hosted-api#streaming | redwood-examples/streaming-chat-prod-ready/README.md | Ibrahim Khan / Sabrina James | In progress | Gap: doc section for “common streaming disconnects” and recommended retry/reconnect patterns. Support ticket SUP-18488 is the reference. |
| STEP-05 | Add timeouts + retries | Client has explicit timeouts and bounded retries with backoff | https://docs.redwoodinference.com/guides/retries-and-timeouts | https://docs.redwoodinference.com/quickstarts/production-readiness#timeouts-and-retries | redwood-examples/streaming-chat-prod-ready/src/client.ts | Monica Patel / Ibrahim Khan | Draft | Need language parity: Python + TS + Go sections should match. Also clarify idempotency guidance (safe retry conditions). |
| STEP-06 | Handle rate limits (429) | Client backs off on 429; user knows where to view quotas | https://docs.redwoodinference.com/guides/rate-limits-and-quotas | https://docs.redwoodinference.com/quickstarts/production-readiness#rate-limits | redwood-examples/streaming-chat-prod-ready/src/retry.ts | Cole Summers / Priya Shah | Draft | Gap: current docs explain limits but not “what you see in first week” (bursty tests). Include a short FAQ: “why did I hit 429 on day 1?” Reference SUP-18510. |
| STEP-07 | View usage & costs in Console | User can find usage dashboard + understands reporting latency | https://docs.redwoodinference.com/console/usage-and-billing | https://docs.redwoodinference.com/quickstarts/production-readiness#usage-dashboard | redwood-quickstarts/production-readiness/README.md#usage-and-costs | Chris Osei / Nadia Rahman | Draft | Gap: explain dashboard lag/data freshness (SUP-18544). Add “what counts as a request/tokens” callout to reduce mismatch confusion. |
| STEP-08 | Set budgets / alerts (cost control) | User sets a budget alert or quota/budget threshold | https://docs.redwoodinference.com/guides/budgets-and-alerts | https://docs.redwoodinference.com/quickstarts/production-readiness#budgets-and-alerts | redwood-terraform/examples/budget-alerts/main.tf | Cole Summers / Sabrina James | In progress | Need Console screenshots + “starter thresholds” guidance. Terraform snippet exists (pr-233) but docs page still stubby. |
| STEP-09 | Pin a model version | User pins a specific model + version for production | https://docs.redwoodinference.com/models/versioning-and-pinning | https://docs.redwoodinference.com/quickstarts/production-readiness#pin-your-model | redwood-quickstarts/production-readiness/README.md#model-pinning | Nikhil Sharma / Benji Okafor | Draft | Gap: clarify what “compatible variants” means and what changes require a repin. Needs a short section on rollout safety. |
| STEP-10 | Configure fallback policy | User sets fallback to a compatible model/region/capacity tier | https://docs.redwoodinference.com/guides/fallback-and-routing-policies | https://docs.redwoodinference.com/quickstarts/production-readiness#fallback-policy | redwood-quickstarts/production-readiness/config/fallback-policy.example.json | Ethan Park / Benji Okafor | Draft | Missing: concrete examples for “capacity constrained” vs “error rate spike” and recommended defaults for new users. |
| STEP-11 | Add request IDs + structured logs | Logs contain request_id/trace_id to debug failures | https://docs.redwoodinference.com/guides/observability/logging | https://docs.redwoodinference.com/quickstarts/production-readiness#logging-and-request-ids | redwood-examples/streaming-chat-prod-ready/src/logger.ts | Logan Wright / Caleb Johnson | Draft | Ensure docs cover both gateway-provided request id header and SDK-level hooks. Need to confirm header names are stable. |
| STEP-12 | Add tracing hooks (optional) | Basic tracing integrated (OpenTelemetry) | https://docs.redwoodinference.com/guides/observability/tracing | https://docs.redwoodinference.com/quickstarts/production-readiness#tracing | redwood-examples/streaming-chat-prod-ready/src/tracing.ts | Allison Grant | Backlog | Not required for MVP checklist completion, but should be a “recommended” step for production launch checklist. Need minimal OTel guide. |
| STEP-13 | Production smoke test | User runs a small load test + confirms latency/error budget | https://docs.redwoodinference.com/guides/production-smoke-test | https://docs.redwoodinference.com/quickstarts/production-readiness#smoke-test | redwood-quickstarts/production-readiness/scripts/smoke_test.sh | Sean Gallagher / Leila Farouk | Backlog | Docs page does not exist yet (new). Could be a short guide + script; keep lightweight for MVP.

Checklist deep-link rules (Console)
- Each step should have:
  - Primary action: deep-link to Console page when possible (API keys, usage, quotas/budgets, model settings).
  - Secondary action (“Learn more”): canonical docs URL from table.
  - Optional: “View example” link if we have a single best reference example (ideally 1 per step).

Known gaps / hotspots (top support drivers)
1) Streaming disconnects: docs need explicit guidance and reconnection patterns (tie to SDK helpers).
2) 429 handling: docs need copy that matches what new customers experience during burst testing; include backoff recipe.
3) Usage dashboard lag: document expected delay and where to check raw usage vs aggregated dashboards.
4) Budgets/alerts: we have Terraform snippets but missing a Console-first walkthrough and recommended starter thresholds.

Next actions
- Wei: finalize canonical URLs once docs IA redirects are locked (Confluence: onboarding-checklist-information-architecture).
- Sabrina: verify each example path exists post-merge of redwood-examples/pr-506 + redwood-quickstarts/pr-377.
- Elliot: add redirect list for any renamed pages and confirm URL permanence for Console deep-links.
- Priya + Dev Patel: sanity check wording for the four hotspots above vs common ticket language.

Change log (manual)
- 2025-02-12: Initial map created from checklist template + docs IA draft.
- 2025-03-01: Added budgets/alerts + model pinning + fallback policy rows.
- 2025-03-26: Updated links to reflect docs PRs (912/926) and new production readiness quickstart (377).
